evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26koy (AT2026zyf) in galaxy UGC 00279 at magnitude, m_w = 19.27 +/- 0.28. At a distance of 83 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD 61280.09 (2026-08-28.09) with an absolute magnitude, M = -15.5 +/- 0.3. The last non-detection (5-sigma; unforced) was on MJD 61279.50. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.

publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26koy (AT2026zyf) in galaxy UGC 00279 at magnitude, m_w = 19.27 +/- 0.28. At a distance of 83 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD 61280.09 (2026-08-28.09) with an absolute magnitude, M = -15.5 +/- 0.3. The last non-detection (5-sigma; unforced) was on MJD 61279.50. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
